question: Since she was always written of as having a scary face, I thought "She must be fairly rough-looking.", but when I saw the illustration of her, it was different than I had imagined, and cute. How was it when you saw the illustration, Professor Cat? Was it different than your mental image, perhaps?
answer: I don't have a mental image of the characters when I'm writing, so what Ootsuka-sensei draws is my image. Hence, it's never been different from my mental image, and it never will be.
